value.rationale: A current full-Fock Toeplitz Szego theorem leaves concrete mixed-word computations open. The natural minimal heterogeneous prefix code has an explicit full atomic law, exact normalizing frequencies, an unexpectedly rational zero atom and a strong TV limit despite the general theorem giving only weak convergence. These invariants distinguish finite-section behavior that equal-word-length reductions miss, so the value is structural and not based solely on correctness or reproducibility.
